title: Fluent but Foreign: Even Regional LLMs Lack Cultural Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using community-grounded surveys and benchmarks (World Values Survey, GlobalOpinionQA, CulturalBench, and NormAd) to assess value orientation, opinion alignment, factual cultural knowledge, and adaptation to social norms. Additionally, conducting a user study to analyze whether AI writing suggestions homogenize Indian cultural expressions toward Western styles.
